# Brie Cakes

> Custom cakes, birthday cakes, wedding cakes, baby shower cakes, and event cakes by Brie Cakes, serving Somerset West, Stellenbosch, and Cape Town.

Canonical site: https://brieevents.co.za/
Brand: Brie Cakes
Owner and baker: Polite Ndoro
Primary service area: Somerset West, Western Cape, South Africa
Additional service areas: Stellenbosch and Cape Town
Contact: WhatsApp or call +27 68 553 3304
Email: politendoro@gmail.com

## Services

- Custom birthday cakes
- Kids birthday cakes and themed birthday cakes
- Personalised and bespoke cake designs
- Wedding cakes and event cakes
- Baby shower cakes, bridal shower cakes, engagement cakes, graduation cakes, and anniversary cakes
- Cupcakes, bento cakes, sweet treats, and savoury party platters

## Ordering Notes

Standard items usually need at least 1 week notice. Custom cakes are best requested at least 2 weeks ahead. Pricing depends on size, flavor, theme, design detail, decorations, timing, collection, and delivery needs.
